_comment: A resist_aura that grants the caster and allies in a 1.5-unit radius a fire-damage multiplier of 0.6, dropping by 0.05 per level (lower is better). The buff lasts long enough that anyone standing in range never lets it lapse, so the cost only charges once when the aura goes on and again for each new ally who walks in, not per tick. All values placeholder.
name: FireWard
